stem.text: Which reaction pathway diagram shows an endothermic reaction that occurs in two steps and in which the second step of the reaction is likely to be faster than the first?

A.alt: Energy profile against extent of reaction with two maxima. The first maximum is higher than the second. The product energy is below the reactant energy.

B.alt: Energy profile against extent of reaction with two maxima. The second maximum is higher than the first. The product energy is below the reactant energy.

C.alt: Energy profile against extent of reaction with two maxima. The first maximum is higher than the second. The product energy is above the reactant energy.

D.alt: Energy profile against extent of reaction with two maxima. The second maximum is higher than the first. The product energy is above the reactant energy.
